scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web,app -c blue,magenta,green "DESKTOP_TOKEN=dev-desktop-token npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web" "DESKTOP_TOKEN=dev-desktop-token DEV_URL=http://localhost:5173 npm run dev -w desktop"
scripts.dev:web: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w desktop
scripts.install-app: npm run package -w desktop && npm run install-app -w desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w desktop && npm run typecheck -w mobile && npm run typecheck -w worker
scripts.android: npm run build:app -w web && npm run sync -w mobile
